{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"tools":[{"name":"search_policy_documents","description":"Search fictional policy documents for a rule or reporting deadline.

        Use a short topic such as 'vehicle damage reporting'. Returns matching source
        text, not an individual claim's status, notes, or a coverage decision.
        ","inputSchema":{"properties":{"query":{"title":"Query","type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"title":"search_policy_documentsArguments","type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"properties":{"result":{"title":"Result","type":"string"}},"required":["result"],"title":"search_policy_documentsOutput","type":"object"}},{"name":"read_policy","description":"Read one named policy's exact wording and reporting deadline.
        Choose THIS tool when the question contains a policy number, especially after a
        read_policy error. search_policy_documents is a topic search, not lookup recovery.
        Pass the supplied identifier first. If the error gives a separator-only correction,
        your NEXT step must call THIS tool with the corrected policy_number, once.
        Otherwise ask the user to confirm the identifier. Do not use it for claim status or notes.
        Never guess policy facts after a failed lookup and never decide claim coverage.
        ","inputSchema":{"properties":{"policy_number":{"title":"Policy Number","type":"string"}},"required":["policy_number"],"title":"read_policyArguments","type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"properties":{"result":{"title":"Result","type":"string"}},"required":["result"],"title":"read_policyOutput","type":"object"}}]}}

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"contents":[{"uri":"policy://exclusions","mimeType":"text/plain","text":"Fictional exclusions schedule: wear and tear, deliberate damage, and pre-existing damage are excluded. This context does not decide coverage for any individual claim. Never infer approval from a claim status or an adjuster note."}]}}

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"[policy:POL-2024-0001] Policy POL-2024-0001 is a fictional motor policy. Report accidental vehicle damage within 7 days. Submit photographs and a repair estimate. A claim status is administrative progress, not a coverage decision.\n[policy:POL-2024-0002] Policy POL-2024-0002 is a fictional home policy. Report escape-of-water damage within 14 days. Submit photographs and the plumber's report. An adjuster must review the evidence before a coverage decision."}],"structuredContent":{"result":"[policy:POL-2024-0001] Policy POL-2024-0001 is a fictional motor policy. Report accidental vehicle damage within 7 days. Submit photographs and a repair estimate. A claim status is administrative progress, not a coverage decision.\n[policy:POL-2024-0002] Policy POL-2024-0002 is a fictional home policy. Report escape-of-water damage within 14 days. Submit photographs and the plumber's report. An adjuster must review the evidence before a coverage decision."},"isError":false}}
